headline: Spanish President Proposes Tax on Fortunes Over 100 Million Euros
summary: Spain's prime minister proposed a tax on fortunes over 100 million euros, with proceeds intended to finance parental leave and housing benefits.
why: Tax policy changes affect high-net-worth investors, domestic fiscal balances and government bond supply in Spain.
original_headline: Presidente de España propone impuesto para fortunas de más de 100 millones de euros
